lines.text: Many learners say: I am very bad today.
Better: I feel very bad today.
Use feel for how you are.

data.why: Use feel for how you are.

native.tip: „I am bad“ heißt „Ich bin böse“. Für dein Befinden nimmst du „I feel“.
native.caption: „I am bad“ klingt nach Bösewicht! 😅 Falsch: “I am very bad today.” Richtig: “I feel very bad today.” Hör Ama zu und sprich nach! Mehr üben in der Lexkite-App.

en.hook: “I am bad” sounds like a villain!
en.tip: “I am bad” means you are evil. To say how you feel, use “I feel”.
en.caption: “I am bad” sounds like a villain! Wrong: “I am very bad today.” Right: “I feel very bad today.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
